description:
Check out Greptile, the best AI code reviewer I've ever used: https://jetty.to/greptile

So Bun just ported their entire Zig codebase to Rust, and they did it with AI. This is absolutely fascinating, on both accounts! So I decided to dive into how they did it, what the Rust code actaully looks like and if it's good or AI slop, what the original Zig codebase looked like, why Bun did this, and a whole lot more. This was a fun one!
